articles.summary: CHARLOTTE, N.C. , May 22, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- The Cato Corporation (NYSE: CATO) today reported net income of $3.3 million or $0.17 per diluted share for the first quarter ended May 3, 2025 , compared to net income of $11.0 million or $0.54 per diluted share for the first quarter ended May 4, 2024
articles.title: CATO REPORTS 1Q EARNINGS
